entities.name: Pedro José Ramón Gual Escandón
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pedro José Ramón Gual Escandón, was a Venezuelan lawyer, politician, journalist and diplomat who was President of Venezuela for three short periods in 1858, 1859 and 1861. In 1861, he was ousted from power in a military coup.
